verdict.rationale: A probe confirms GitHub's own documentation site serves an llms.txt file (HTTP 200 at docs.github.com/llms.txt), so an agent can be pointed at vendor-provided, agent-oriented docs. However, the evidence only shows a general GitHub Docs index. Nothing shows it specifically covers GitHub Mobile, and no other agent-oriented docs for the mobile app are evidenced. Missing for 10: evidence that llms.txt includes GitHub Mobile content, any mobile-specific agent-oriented docs, and hands-on corroboration of agent use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://docs.github.com/llms.txt # GitHub Docs
